derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in wall-with-window.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The wall's stated length and thickness: 12 x 12 = 144", 144 x 1024 = 147456; 5.5 x 1024 = 5632. The opening lies inside the wall, so the extent is the wall's.

boxes.name: Wall
boxes.derivation: Origin of the design. Length 12'-0" = 144" = 147456; thickness 5 1/2" = 5.5 x 1024 = 5632. Occupies x 0..147456, y 0..5632.

boxes.name: Opening
boxes.derivation: Width 3'-0" = 36" = 36864. Centred on the wall: the wall's centre is at 144 / 2 = 72", the opening's half-width is 36 / 2 = 18", so its west edge is at 72 - 18 = 54" = 54 x 1024 = 55296 and its east edge at 54 + 36 = 90" = 92160. It runs the full thickness of the wall, so its height equals the wall's, 5632, and its anchor y is the wall's, 0.

dimensionLabels.name: Wall thickness
dimensionLabels.derivation: 5632 / 1024 = 5.5"; under a foot, so no feet are shown: 5 and 8/16 reduced to 1/2.

dimensionLabels.name: Wall west end to opening
dimensionLabels.derivation: The opening's south-west corner is at x = 55296 and the wall's at x = 0: 55296 - 0 = 55296 = 54" = 4 x 12 + 6.

dimensionLabels.name: Opening to wall east end
dimensionLabels.derivation: The wall's south-east corner is at x = 147456 and the opening's at 55296 + 36864 = 92160: 147456 - 92160 = 55296 = 54". The two reference dimensions and the opening add up: 54 + 36 + 54 = 144", which is the wall's length.

cutListOrder: Empty by construction: a wall and an opening are boxes that nobody cuts, so both carry "part": null in the scene and the cut list collects nothing. That is the case the cut list must not treat as an error.
cutListCsv: Cut list: finished sizes before saw kerf and joinery allowance.
notes: M1 is a geometry and labelling fixture only: entity positions and the exact feet-inch-fraction text of each dimension label.
Format version 2 gave every entity a name and every box a part. This fixture's two boxes are not parts, so they carry "part": null; their names are the ones this file already stated.

No header size, stud count or bracing length is expected here. Those arrive in M4 and M5, read by a person from Connecticut's published adopted text with the page cited, never from memory and never from napkin's own output.
